faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Climate Change Mission (DCCM Sivaganga).

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited under DCCM Sivaganga Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post notified is Technical Assistant on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 15 October 2026 till 6 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy, or similar / allied fields.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 40 years or below.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated remuneration offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How can I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted by email to [email protected] or in person at the District Collectorate, A Section, 1st floor, District Collectorate, Sivagangai.

faq.question: Q9. Is residency mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include being a resident of the Sivagangai district.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The time period of the contract is 19 months.
